SELECT id,
    user_id,
    title,
    category,
    domain,
    source,
    source_uri,
    mime,
    ingest_status,
    embedding_model,
    content_hash,
    version,
    confidence,
    COALESCE(doc_status,
        CASE
            WHEN category = 'recherche'::text THEN 'finding'::text
            ELSE 'user'::text
        END) AS doc_status,
    doc_status IS NULL AS doc_status_derived,
    last_verified_at,
    last_written_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM knowledge_base kb;

views.definition:
SELECT id,
    user_id,
    session_id,
    scope,
    type,
    level,
    goal,
    content,
    metadata,
    project_id,
    source_task_id,
    evidence_ids,
    confidence,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'validated'::text AND validated_by IS NULL AND NOT metadata ? 'validated_by'::text AND (jsonb_typeof(evidence_ids) <> 'array'::text OR jsonb_array_length(evidence_ids) = 0) THEN 'proposed'::text
            ELSE status
        END AS status,
    status AS stored_status,
    COALESCE(validated_by, NULLIF(metadata ->> 'validated_by'::text, ''::text)::uuid) AS validated_by,
    COALESCE(validated_at, NULLIF(metadata ->> 'validated_at'::text, ''::text)::timestamp with time zone) AS validated_at,
    expires_at,
    is_simulation,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM agent_memory m
  WHERE expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now();
